plate.narration: At the forest entrance, a fern unrolls toward the path. An acorn balances on its tip. The brambles ahead are waiting too. Before anyone goes farther, the Woods seem to want a little attention.

objectives.label: Found out what the forest was objecting to
Helped the unicorns mend a hurt glade

goal.text: Find out what the forest is counting, and why.

steps.label: Find what hurts the forest most

facet_glade.name: The Glade Stone
facet_glade.text: From the heart of the Woods' worst glade. Warm, loud, and no mosshorn will come near it.

scene_tree_line.narration: Find out what the forest is counting, and why. The Enchanted Woods begin like a green wall. A fern unrolls, looks at you, and rolls up again. Somewhere ahead, the counting has just reached your name.

scene_tree_line_walk_in.narration: You walk in. A root quietly closes the gap behind your boots. Not a trap, maybe. More like a host shutting a door against a draft.

scene_tree_line_wait.narration: You wait at the edge, like at a stranger's front door. At last the fern bends into a low green bow, and the brambles lift aside like a curtain. The forest likes good manners.

scene_se_glades.narration: The southeastern glades are full of bluebells that ring when a boot brushes them. You're early and dry. Back on the far bank, Gullet waves her notched hat. In your pocket is a honeycake she slipped in.

scene_flooded_paths.narration: You come in late and dripping, near MossHome, the bigfoot town. A flood-warden in very tall boots hands you a jar of mosslight. "Happens every season," says the warden. "Not usually to this many."

variants.text: For you, it was the river. It swept you off the ford and through the marsh to here.

scene_runner_path.narration: A bigfoot jogs toward you with knotted cords. The path folds up in front of her, and she jogs in place. "MossHome runner! Third missing path today!" she puffs. "Help me find it?"

check_runner_path.prompt: Work out where a folded-up path has gone

onSuccess.narration: All the ferns along one side are leaning the same way, like people pointing. You follow them, and there's the path, only a little way over, sulking behind a holly bush. The runner whoops. "MossHome is north!" she calls, jogging off. "Come and see us! Bring your feet!"

onFailure.narration: You find a path. It is the wrong one, and it walks you in a neat circle back to the runner, who has found the right one herself while you were gone and is jogging in place, laughing. "Happens to everybody this season," she puffs, and jogs away north.

scene_runner_path_carry.narration: You carry a bundle of cords to the bend. Every knot marks a moved path. "Forest likes records," says the runner. When the way opens, she jogs north, tying another knot.

scene_runner_path_knock.narration: Your bigfoot knocks twice on a trunk and jogs alongside her. The folded path shakes out like a blanket. "Haven't seen a knock like that outside town!" puffs the runner. "MossHome's north. Visit!"

scene_roll_call.narration: In a clearing, the trees rustle names like a teacher taking attendance. A squirrel answers "Here!" A prospector answers, and the path behind him shuts. Now it's your turn.

variants.text: Your tuned charm chimes back, like a hand going up.
Your brave whistle gets an approving rustle.
Over your curl of cold silver, the trees go quiet.
Your mosslight jar glows, as if it likes being counted.
The Barge Stone gets the longest rustle of all.
The Ford Stone gets the longest rustle of all.

scene_roll_call_here.narration: "Here!" The trees count your packs anyway: socks, crumbs, anything that hums. At last a path opens, like a teacher closing a book.

check_roll_call_truth.prompt: Name everything you carry, honestly, even the embarrassing bits

onSuccess.narration: You empty your pockets onto a stump and name everything out loud, even the squashed cookie, even the stone if you have one. The trees rustle warmly, the way grown-ups do when you own up first. A path opens, wide and sunny, and the forest seems to make a little note about you.

onFailure.narration: You name everything, very honestly, and then a frog climbs out of somebody's hood. Nobody knew it was there. It has been there since the river. The trees rustle about this for a long time, and you are fairly sure they are laughing. The frog hops off. A path opens, eventually.

scene_roll_call_charm.narration: You hold up the tuned charm. It rings by itself, the note the stones hum. Then every tree rings the same note back, like a song they all learned long ago. A path opens.

scene_attendance.narration: Paths open ahead of you and close behind three prospectors, whose pockets hum. "That hedge is new!" shouts the boggart prospector, as they walk straight into one. The forest is checking what people carry.

scene_attendance_open_path.narration: The path closes behind you like a door held by a good butler, and the next one opens ahead. Around a bend, somebody is shouting at a hedge. The hedge is not listening.

check_ask_trees.prompt: Ask the forest, politely, what it is objecting to

onSuccess.narration: Something tall creaks, and leans, and leans some more, until it's close enough to whisper.

onFailure.narration: The trees rustle something long and complicated. It might be an answer. It might be a soup recipe. You walk past the same embarrassed toadstool three times before a path lets you through, and on the far side somebody is shouting at a hedge.

scene_forest_objects.narration: An old beech bends down to whisper. It smells of rain. It is not you the forest minds, it says. It is the stones. Where a stone fell, the glade around it hurts. Pocket one, and the forest shuts its doors on you.

scene_hedge.narration: A hedge holds the prospectors by their coats. "We only took what fell!" shouts one. Their pockets hum. Nobody gets left in a hedge.

check_hedge_pull.prompt: Everybody grab a boot and heave the prospectors out of a hedge that does not want to let go

onSuccess.narration: You grab a boot each and heave. Out they pop like corks, one, two, three. But their coats stay in the hedge, and so does everything in the pockets. The gems sink into the leaves, humming, and are gone. The prospectors pat their shirts, then stare at the hedge, then run.

onFailure.narration: You heave. The hedge heaves back, and now it is holding your sleeves too. In a panic, the biggest prospector empties his pockets on the ground, and the moment the gems touch the moss, roots curl around them and pull them under. The hedge lets everybody go at once, as if nothing happened.

scene_hedge_empty.narration: The prospectors empty their humming pockets. The hedge lets go of their coats, one at a time. "Oh," says the loudest. The hedge rustles a satisfied tsk.

scene_hedge_ask.narration: You lower your horn and ask. In the hush you feel the answer: not them, only the stones. The hedge opens its hands, and the gems drop from the prospectors' pockets and sink into the moss.

scene_mosshorns.narration: Mosshorns graze ahead. Their antlers grow tiny gardens, and one has strawberries. When a gem cart passes, the whole herd steps away together. Where won't they graze?

scene_mosshorns_walk_on.narration: You walk on past. A mosshorn follows a little way, as if deciding whether you count as a friend.

check_watch_herd.prompt: Watch the herd long enough to see the pattern

onSuccess.narration: You sit so still a beetle walks across your boot. And then you see it.

onFailure.narration: A mosshorn wanders over, inspects you thoroughly, sneezes on you, and leaves. That, apparently, was the whole conversation. You walk on, and soon your boots find a bare gray patch where nothing grows at all.

scene_read_herd.narration: The mosshorns don't mind people. They mind the stones. They walk wide around anything that hums, and won't graze where a stone fell. The herd is a map of where the forest hurts.

scene_gray_patch.narration: A humming crumb of stone sits in a gray ring of moss. A beetle walks carefully around it. Pocket it and see what the paths do? Or press it gently into the moss?

scene_gray_patch_pocket.narration: You lift the crumb. Paths slam shut. You put it back, and they open again. So you leave it. Now you know what the forest minds.

check_gray_patch_press.prompt: Press the humming crumb down into the moss, gently, the way you'd tuck in a blanket

onSuccess.narration: You press it down, gently, and the moss takes it like a pocket closing. The hum goes muffled, then quiet. And right in the middle of the gray ring, one bright green shoot pokes up and unrolls. A very small mend. Somebody nearby, with ears, has noticed.

onFailure.narration: You press it down. It pops back up. You press it again. It pops up again, like a cork in a bath. On the third try you give up and plant a stick beside it as a flag, so whoever mends these things can find it. Somebody nearby, with ears, has noticed that too.

scene_unicorns.narration: Two unicorns tend a gray glade. "We are mending," says the elder. "Will you help?" Hold the moss for the hum, or guard the edge and learn the woodland sounds. The worst glade, farther north, will need one or the other.

scene_unicorns_horn.narration: You lower your horn to the gray bruise. It feels like pressing a sore knee, then the knee feeling better. Green creeps out in a ring. The elder's ears tip forward: a unicorn's standing ovation.

scene_unicorns_guard.narration: You guard the edge while they mend. Squirrels rustle, a branch taps, a bird answers. You learn to leave gaps between sounds, so no one beat can be followed. That could help at the worst glade.

scene_unicorns_patch.narration: You tell them about the crumb you pressed down and its green shoot. The elder's ears go straight up. "Down," she says. "Not away. Down." She lets you start the mending hum. The moss greens from the middle out.

check_mend.prompt: Everybody hum with the unicorns, hands flat on the moss, while it remembers its color

onSuccess.narration: Green creeps back from the middle, like a spill going backwards. The flowers turn around one by one to face the sun.

onFailure.narration: You hum, and the moss goes green, then gray, then a sort of hopeful beige. The unicorns finish it themselves, very kindly, while you hold their saddlebags.

scene_finding.narration: When the glade is quiet, the elder rests her horn where the stone fell. "These stones are not of the mountain," she says. "The forest remembers them from before the mountain had its name." She says nothing more. Then, quieter: "This was a small one. The worst glade is north of here."

scene_finding_before.narration: The elder touches the ground with one hoof. "Before names," she says. That is all she will say.

scene_finding_how.narration: "Slowly," says the elder. "The forest dislikes hurry. Something in the worst glade listens for loud things. Go quiet, or go so noisy it can't follow." That is a lot of words, for her.

scene_finding_rest.narration: You sit. The elder sits too. A flower turns toward you, changes its mind, and faces the sun.

rest_glade_edge.narration: You rest on the soft green moss. A mosshorn calf falls asleep across your feet. The daisy between its ears folds up for a nap too.

rest_glade_edge_on.narration: You slide your boots out. The calf wakes, sees your empty spot, and decides to follow you. Its daisy pops open in surprise.

rest_glade_edge_lullaby.narration: You hum until the calf relaxes. When it wakes, it knows your tune, and follows without a worried snort.

scene_lost_calf.narration: The calf is still following, all knees and antler buds. Its herd is nowhere in sight. How will you get it home? A sneeze makes its daisy wobble.

check_calf_call.prompt: Hoot like a mosshorn, long and low, so the herd comes for its calf

onSuccess.narration: You hoot, long and low. Far off, something hoots back. Out of the trees comes the strawberry-patch mosshorn and the whole herd behind it. The calf trots home, and the big mosshorn lowers its whole garden of antlers to you, very slowly, which is how mosshorns say thank you.

onFailure.narration: Your hoot comes out like a goose with hiccups. The calf looks at you, embarrassed on your behalf, and hoots properly itself. The herd answers at once and comes to fetch it. As it trots home, the calf looks back at you with deep pity. You have been out-hooted by a baby.

scene_lost_calf_carry.narration: You carry the calf back to its herd. It nibbles your hair on the way. Its mother lowers her garden of antlers in thanks. The herd will help you at the worst glade.

scene_lost_calf_lead.narration: The calf leads you down a mosshorn path under giant ferns, straight into its herd. The big mosshorns sniff your boots, which smell of lullaby, and walk you toward the worst glade.

scene_sitting_beech.narration: A huge beech has sat down across the path, roots tucked under like a grandpa's feet. "Why did you come?" it whispers. A squirrel taps on its shoulder, impatient.

scene_sitting_beech_stones.narration: "The stones," you say. The beech is quiet so long the squirrel falls asleep. "Honest," it whispers at last, and shuffles aside. "Go gently. The glade is sore, and something there is listening."

scene_sitting_beech_passing.narration: "Passing through," the beech repeats slowly. "Everybody is passing through. Even me. I am just slower." It gets up one root at a time, which takes as long as eating a cookie, and waves you on.

scene_sitting_beech_curious.narration: "To find out," the beech repeats, and every leaf rustles, pleased. "Curious. Good." It stands up quite fast, for a beech, and drops a leaf on your shoulder: look closely in there.

scene_sitting_beech_told.narration: "We told the roll call everything," you remind it. The beech creaks with laughter. "I know," it whispers. "The whole forest knows." It gets up at once, the squirrel clinging on, and bows you past.

scene_crater.narration: The worst glade has a crack in its gray floor. Beside it listens a pale, eyeless echo hunter. It hunts by sound. How will you get past it?

scene_crater_steady.narration: Your bigfoot knocks three slow knocks and walks in, slow and steady. Everybody follows in step. A sound that steady is boring. The echo hunter yawns and slides back down its crack.

scene_crater_herd.narration: The mosshorn herd has followed you. Not one hoof steps on the gray, but at the edge they stamp together, a great soft drumming. Far too much to listen to! The echo hunter slides back into its crack.

check_noisy.prompt: Everybody make so many sounds at once that the echo hunter cannot follow any of them

onSuccess.narration: Clapping, stamping, a pot lid, somebody yodeling. The echo hunter's frills flatten in dismay, and it backs down its crack to wait for some peace and quiet.

onFailure.narration: You manage one sound, very loudly, over and over. That is exactly the kind it likes.

check_silent.prompt: Cross the glade without making a single sound

onSuccess.narration: Not a twig. Not a breath. The hunter tilts its head, puzzled, and hears nothing at all.

onFailure.narration: A twig. A snap. A pale head turns.

encounter_echo.narration: The echo hunter rises from its crack, frills spread wide. It is young, about pony-sized. A wisp drifts down to join in.

onVictory.narration: Far too loud! The hunter slides back into the dark, and the wisp drifts off to bother a mosshorn.

onDefeat.narration: The hunter herds you out, nudge by patient nudge. A path closes behind you. The glade is gone.

check_way_back.prompt: Find the hidden way back to the worst glade

onSuccess.narration: You follow the gray patches the mosshorns won't graze, and they lead you straight back. Late and scuffed, but there.

onFailure.narration: The gray patches lead you in a circle, and then into a hedge, and then past an embarrassed-looking toadstool, twice. The forest has decided where you are going, and it is not the glade.

scene_glade_heart.narration: In the middle of the worst glade sits a humming gem the size of a fist. Every tree leans away. "Mend the glade, and the stone sinks back into the ground," says the Elder Unicorn. "Take it, and the glade never mends." Everybody vote.

scene_mend_glade.narration: You press the stone gently into the moss. Green spreads outward. The flowers turn, and the unicorns bow. The stone stays with the forest.

scene_pocket_stone.narration: The Glade Stone hums in your pocket. The gray moss stays gray. The unicorns say nothing. One of them writes something down.

scene_pile_shown.narration: A new path leads you past a huge hollow oak. Inside are pickaxes, a feathered hat and dozens of humming gems. The forest has been confiscating! It shows you like a secret drawer, then closes its bark like a lid.

scene_pile_shown_on.narration: You say nothing, and the oak says nothing back. Between people and trees, that is a promise. All the way north, every path opens a moment before you reach it.

scene_pile_shown_ask.narration: You ask. The answer comes in creaks and drips, slow as sap: until somebody comes who can be trusted with them. The bigfoot keep the record. Ask at MossHome. Then a path opens north.

scene_pile_glimpsed.narration: The paths close one by one, until the only way left squeezes past a huge hollow oak. Inside are pickaxes, a feathered hat and dozens of humming gems. The forest has been confiscating! A branch gives your pocket a long look.

scene_pile_glimpsed_on.narration: You hurry. Paths open only at the last moment, like a door somebody might still slam. The Glade Stone hums the whole way, very pleased with itself. A bramble catches your sleeve, twice, on purpose.

scene_pile_glimpsed_sorry.narration: "Sorry," you tell the oak. "We're keeping it." A long creak, like somebody thinking. Then one leaf drifts onto your pocket, right over the stone, like a label. The forest will remember who has it.

ending_marked_present.narration: You camp at the northern edge of the Woods, on moss soft as a pillow. At dusk the MossHome runner jogs by. "MossHome's just north!" All night a mosshorn guards your fire. The forest has marked you present.

variants.text: The unicorns' moss got you across.
Your guard duty taught you the chorus.
The herd's map led you back.

ending_marked_something.narration: You camp at the northern edge of the Woods. At dusk the MossHome runner jogs by. "MossHome's just north!" The Glade Stone hums all night, and no mosshorn comes near. Next to your name, the forest wrote something you can't read.

variants.text: The unicorns' moss got you across.
Your guard duty taught you the chorus.
The herd's map led you back.

ending_shown_the_door.narration: When you find your way back, the worst glade is already green. The unicorns mended it without you. The forest walks you to its northern edge, like a guest to the door. At dusk the MossHome runner waves. "MossHome's just north!"

variants.text: The unicorns' moss got you across.
Your guard duty taught you the chorus.
The herd's map led you back.

interaction_sapling_rhyme.narration: Little saplings rustle a rhyme as you pass: "Fern, acorn, bluebell, acorn." The tallest bows so low that a neighbor has to help it up. A path winks open between them.

interaction_hedge_gate.narration: Now the hedge knits its branches into a green gate with one thorny latch. It sits there looking innocent.

interaction.cue: Friends hold the branches apart while someone slips the latch.

onSuccess.narration: Click! The gate swings wide, and three dropped coins fall from the latch. "Finders, keepers," rustle the leaves.

onFailure.narration: The latch snaps onto your sleeve. The hedge sighs and opens the gate itself. "Tsk."

onAssisted.narration: A bramble holds the branches while you slip the latch. Click! Three dropped coins tumble out.

interaction_herd_friends.narration: The moss ahead is going gray. Behind you, hoofsteps: the strawberry mosshorn. It stops at the gray edge and looks at you. Mosshorns pick friends slowly.

interaction.cue: Be gentle and kind until the mosshorn lowers its antlers.

options.label: Hum a slow tune
options.reaction: The mosshorn tilts its antlers and listens.

options.label: Scratch behind its ears
options.reaction: It leans into your hand and a strawberry wobbles.

options.label: Offer a handful of clover
options.reaction: It chews, thoughtfully, with its eyes shut.

stages: It lowers its whole garden to you.

onSuccess.narration: The mosshorn slowly lowers its antlers. That means "friend." It drops a strawberry in your hand, then stays behind.

onFailure.narration: The mosshorn slowly lowers its antlers. That means "friend." It drops a strawberry in your hand, then stays behind.

interaction_spring_cup.narration: A young unicorn steps out of the ferns with a leaf full of spring water. You carry it together to a thirsty glade without spilling a drop. "For later," she says, handing you a tiny bottle of sunbloom nectar.

interaction_calf_hide.narration: The calf sneezes and decides to play. It dives behind one fern, then another. Three ferns are shaking. Which one is it behind?

interaction.cue: Watch the calf dive between the ferns, then pick where it ends up.

onSuccess.narration: There it is, grinning, a daisy over one ear!

onFailure.narration: You find a surprised frog. The calf breathes on your neck from behind. Beaten by a baby!

onAssisted.narration: The calf leaves one ear sticking out, which is kind of it. Found you!

scene_beech_squirrel.narration: You press a coin into the squirrel's paw. It bites the coin and whispers in the beech's ear. "Fine," creaks the beech, shuffling aside. The squirrel hands you a plum-sized acorn. "Throw it hard. It goes bang."

scene_stepping_logs.narration: Two mossy logs cross the only brook into the worst glade. A row of left boots waits on the bank. A toadstool opens an eye. Mire mimics! They want your right boots too.

encounter_logs.narration: The logs heave up out of the brook on long, muddy legs. Make them let go of the bridge!

scene_logs_cleared.narration: The logs decide boots are not worth the trouble and slide away. Safe stepping stones appear under the water. You cross, leaving the left boots in a neat row.

scene_logs_slipped.narration: The logs roll you into the shallows. Sitting in the brook, you spot stepping stones under the water. You cross, dripping. The left boots are somebody else's problem.

interaction_forest_inventory.narration: Say out loud what your hero carries. Then choose how to add it to the roll call. The trees wait. A squirrel checks behind its own ears.

interaction_herd_map.narration: A hoof-glow marks the last safe grazing patch. Follow it to the herd's safe edge. A map of the gray could help later.

interaction.cue: Follow the hoof-glow and choose its final safe patch.

onSuccess.narration: You find the safe edge. Beyond it, the herd avoids every gray patch.

onFailure.narration: A mosshorn sniffs you, sneezes, and leaves. Soon your boots find a bare gray patch.

onAssisted.narration: The mosshorn points with its nose. Together you find the safe edge.

interaction_small_mend.narration: Press the crumb into the soft spot when the marker meets the gold. A beetle waits nearby, as if it has an appointment.

interaction.cue: Press when the marker is inside the gold soft spot.

onSuccess.narration: The moss takes the crumb like a pocket closing. One green shoot pokes up. Somebody with ears has noticed.

onFailure.narration: It pops back up like a cork. You mark the spot with a stick. Somebody with ears has noticed.

onAssisted.narration: A fern steadies your fingers. The crumb sinks in, and a green shoot opens.

interaction_mending_circle.narration: Hold the loose moss while the acting hero carries the hum across. Alone, use the support prop. Flowers turn to check your work.

interaction.cue: Hold the moss steady while the acting hero carries the hum.

onSuccess.narration: Green spreads. The unicorns show you how to lay a quiet strip of moss.

onFailure.narration: The moss goes green, then gray, then a hopeful beige. The unicorns finish it.

onAssisted.narration: The elder braces the moss with you. You mend it, and learn to lay a quiet strip.

interaction_calf_load.narration: A broad cloth holds the calf. Raise or lower your end until it is level, then carry it home. The calf tastes the cloth. Disappointing.

interaction.cue: Raise or lower your side to level the calf's sling.

onSuccess.narration: The sling stays level all the way to the waiting herd.

onFailure.narration: The calf's mother fetches it before you finish. It is safe, but the herd will not walk with you.

onAssisted.narration: A low branch holds the sling while you level it. You carry the calf home.

interaction_quiet_moss.narration: Hold the moss strip flat, the way the unicorns taught you, while the acting hero guides the crossing. The echo hunter listens hard.

interaction.cue: Hold the moss strip flat while the acting hero guides the crossing.

onSuccess.narration: The moss hushes your steps. The hunter hears nothing, and you reach the middle.

onFailure.narration: The strip lifts with a snap. The hunter turns toward you.

onAssisted.narration: A root holds the far edge for you. You reach the middle with help.

interaction_guard_chorus.narration: Leave room for the woodland: a clap between squirrel rustles, a stamp after a birdcall. Choose your sound, and make it out loud if you like.

interaction.cue: Each hero adds a sound between the woodland's answers.

options.label: Stamp after the birdcall
options.reaction: A bird answers before your stamp can repeat.

options.label: Brush leaves under the tapping branch
options.reaction: The branch taps across your leaf-rustle.

onSuccess.narration: The hunter cannot pick one sound out of your chorus. It slips away.

onFailure.narration: The woodland fills in your sounds, and the hunter backs away.

onAssisted.narration: The woodland fills the gaps while you add sounds. The hunter backs away.

scene_echo_recovery.narration: The echo hunter has pushed you out, and the path is gone. Can you find your way back to the worst glade?

interaction_gray_route.narration: Share what you saw: safe ferns, then the gray ring, then the hollow. Put the route in order. The mosshorns won't step on the gray, but they show you its edge.

interaction.cue: Share the map clues and rebuild the route to the hollow.
clues: The safe ferns come before the gray ring.
The worst hollow is beyond the gray ring.
Follow the edges; the herd never walked on the gray.

onSuccess.narration: You follow the edges back to the hollow. What the herd showed you saved the day.

onFailure.narration: The edges lead you in a loop. The forest shows you out.

onAssisted.narration: The trees rustle at each mark, and help you back to the hollow.

interaction_forest_inventory_response_na.narration: The leaves rustle after your list. The forest has heard you, and opens a path. It will remember what you told it.

interaction_forest_inventory_response_ch.narration: A fern helps lift the edge of a hood, just in case. One pocket at a time, you check and name what you carry.

interaction_forest_inventory_response_he.narration: The trees wait while a friend helps you check. One pocket at a time, you name what you carry.

voiceGuide.tone: green, hushed and watchful; the forest is a polite host keeping a ledger, a little spooky but never scary
forbidden: explaining what the Hollow Gate is

npcVoices.beech_tree: old, slow, smells of rain; whispers in long sentences and never raises its voice
npcVoices.elder_unicorn: calm, few words, frowns with her ears; says the important thing once and stops
npcVoices.flood_warden: MossHome bigfoot in very tall boots; brisk, practical, has seen every kind of soggy
npcVoices.echo_hunter: never speaks; tilts its frilled head, listening, filing every sound
npcVoices.runner: a MossHome runner; cheerful, out of breath, never stops jogging even while talking, carries bundles of knotted cords
npcVoices.hedge_prospectors: prospectors held by a hedge; loud, indignant, then sheepish once their pockets are empty

interaction_sapling_rhyme.narration: The path is open, but one more ring of trees is not finished with you. A row of saplings, none taller than a boot, rustles a little rhyme, leaf by leaf. Then they all go quiet and turn toward you. They are learning to take attendance, and they would like to hear it said back, in the right order.

interaction.cue: Watch the saplings rustle, then rustle it back in the same order.

onSuccess.narration: Fern, acorn, bluebell, acorn. The saplings shake from top to toe, as pleased as anything. The tallest one bows so low it tips over, and the others have to help it up. A path winks open between them.

onFailure.narration: You get the fern right, and then everything else tumbles out in a heap. The saplings giggle and rustle it back for you, slowly, so you can hear how it goes. Fern, acorn, bluebell, acorn. A path winks open between them, and one sapling follows you for a few steps, still rustling.

onAssisted.narration: The saplings rustle the rhyme once more, nice and slow, and this time you say it back in time with them. Fern, acorn, bluebell, acorn. A path winks open between them.

interaction_spring_cup.narration: A young unicorn trots out of the ferns. She looks at the gray patch, and then at your hands. "The glade ahead is dry as toast," she says. "The elders are mending it, and the moss wants spring water. A whole cup, carried flat. My hooves are no good with cups." She holds out a big curled leaf, brimming. "Will you carry it?"

interaction.cue: Everyone lift or lower your side until the water is flat, then carry the cup.
interaction.objectLabel: A leaf cup of spring water

onSuccess.narration: Not a drop spills. "Flat as a pond," the young unicorn breathes, and leads you the rest of the way to the small glade. At its edge she digs in her saddlebag. "For later," she says, and presses a tiny bottle of sunbloom nectar into your hand.

onFailure.narration: The cup tips, and the water goes all down the front of the nearest boot. "It is only a little wet," the young unicorn says, kindly, and fetches a second leaf from a fern. She leads you the rest of the way to the small glade, ears politely not laughing.

onAssisted.narration: The young unicorn steadies one edge of the leaf with her nose, and the water lies flat. "Flat as a pond," she breathes. She leads you the rest of the way to the small glade, and at its edge presses a tiny bottle of sunbloom nectar into your hand. "For later."

interaction_forest_inventory.narration: Say what your hero carries aloud, then choose how to add it to the roll call. The trees wait. A squirrel checks behind its own ears. Nobody here is being graded on how brave an answer sounds.

interaction.cue: Each hero names their things and adds to the roll call.

options.label: Name the things I know
options.reaction: The leaves rustle after your list.

options.label: Check my pockets and hood
options.reaction: A fern helps lift the edge of a hood. Just in case.

options.label: Ask a friend to help me check
options.reaction: The trees wait while the check is finished together.

onSuccess.narration: Your checked account is heard. The forest opens a path and remembers that you offered it.

onFailure.narration: The trees finish the roll call beside you and open the path.

onAssisted.narration: The trees prompt you through one pocket at a time. With their help, you check and name what you carry.
